manual_review_notes: F01 C restrictions cite same Fidelity Contrafund Class K, not the distinct Contrafund K6 portfolio; only fund-wide investment rules are used.
VPMCX SAI 50%-basket language explicitly excludes PRIMECAP. The subsequent single-issuer 25% rule applies to each fund.
TRBCX common SAI explicitly excludes Blue Chip Growth from diversified-fund issuer caps; 25% industry rule uses NAV and provider/adviser taxonomy.
FCNTX illiquid rule changed 10% to 15% in May 15 2026 amendment; this is applied only in C.
SIC is current official issuer fallback with retrospective classification; h uses mapped eligible equity and q_NAV uses matched same-source NAV.
A historical shareholder-performance commentary is labeled historical, not relabeled forward-looking outlook; common FOMC March/June outlook serves the corresponding source-date windows.
